{
  "$schema": "https://ui.shadcn.com/schema/registry-item.json",
  "name": "producer-pipeline-legend",
  "type": "registry:block",
  "title": "Pipeline Legend",
  "description": "One compact stock Card row: the step and edge counts (and the untyped file count) as the description, and one stock Badge per node kind as the card action, each with its meaning in a stock Tooltip.",
  "author": "Clossys",
  "dependencies": [],
  "registryDependencies": [
    "components.badge",
    "components.card",
    "components.tooltip"
  ],
  "files": [
    {
      "path": "index.tsx",
      "type": "registry:component",
      "target": "studio/sections/producer-pipeline-legend/index.tsx"
    }
  ]
}

element.reason: Round 3 readability (owner: shadcn-compatible, no hand-rolling, standard layout): the counts that sat in the pipeline-header and the kind legend that sat in a Table become one compact stock Card header row above the canvas; meanings move into the stock Tooltip on each Badge. Stock parts and props only.
